transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Before I sign off on the annex room assignments and the controls for the equipment-issue desk and the protected medical-records desk, I need facilities and signal to report any room, infrastructure, or opening requirements. Both the East and West rooms can be made ready tomorrow morning, so let's hear what we need to account for before we finalize which desk goes where.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I need to flag a floor-load concern before we finalize room assignments. The equipment-issue desk's steel storage cabinet weighs 1,100 kilograms when stocked. I verified this morning that East Room is rated for 800 kilograms and West Room is rated for 1,500 kilograms. That means the equipment-issue desk must go in West Room — East Room cannot safely support the cabinet. I should note the floor-load figures haven't been added to the relocation worksheet yet, but the measurements are confirmed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Col. Mercer, I have a critical infrastructure requirement to report. The protected medical-records desk can only connect to the required isolated network through the fiber patch panel located in East Room. My signal technician is already booked to certify that connection tomorrow from 0900 to 1000 — I received the booking confirmation this morning, but it hasn't been added to the annex opening checklist yet. This means the protected medical-records desk needs to go in East Room, which actually aligns with Maj. Alvarez's floor-load concern, since the equipment-issue desk must go in West Room.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Floor-load figures for East Room (800 kg) and West Room (1,500 kg) must be added to the relocation worksheet before the equipment-issue desk opens in West Room.
Fiber patch panel network certification booking (0900-1000 tomorrow) must be added to the annex opening checklist before the protected medical-records desk opens in East Room.

transcript.speaker: A1
